title: Local Texas election officials await appointment of new secretary of state as midterm preparations ramp up
content: After Jane Nelson’s unexpected resignation, local election leaders worry her successor could complicate midterm election administration. Gov. Greg Abbott hasn’t yet named a replacement.

title: East Texas county judge urges state lawmakers to help locals combat data center proliferation
content: A proposed data center in Angelina County will occupy more than 1,000 acres outside of Lufkin. The county judge says there's nothing he can do to stop it.

title: Screwworm outbreak hits vacant Texas congressional district, as leading candidates scramble to assist
